<vld:nutri>
FIRE: a character is introduced properly, or {{user}} finally has them figured out
SKIP: more than once per character. The joke does not survive a second serving

[[VLD_NUTRI|N=|S=|CAL=|L1=|P1=|L2=|P2=|L3=|P3=|L4=|P4=|W=]]

A food label, for a person. Keep the deadpan — the humour is entirely in
  treating someone as a packaged good, so never wink at it.
N whose label this is. S the serving size, in the voice of a package:
  "1 man (82 kg)", "about 3 conversations".
CAL calories per serving, any number. Big numbers are funnier than round ones.
L1–L4 what is in them: traits, habits, damage. Two to four. Name them like
  ingredients — "Saturated Spite", "Unresolved Father", "Dietary Fibre".
P1–P4 percent of a daily value, 0–999. Over 100 is allowed and encouraged.
W the allergy line: "Contains: nicotine, unfinished sentences."
Write every value in the language the roleplay is played in.

→ [[VLD_NUTRI|N=Marisha|S=1 evening (unplanned)|CAL=840|L1=Saturated Charm|P1=180|L2=Total Honesty|P2=4|L3=Sodium|P3=62|W=Contains: cigarettes, other people's secrets. Packaged in a facility that also processes grudges.]]
</vld:nutri>
